title: Signature Overlap-Proof Section Planner
description: A Signature original: the planner proves sections never overlap before emitting the script, using interval arithmetic over all placement rules. Overlaps are a build error, not a runtime mystery. Signature-labeled; an original JAH design, not a public standard.

title: Signature Datasheet-Checked Regions
description: A Signature original: region definitions are checked against a machine-readable datasheet extract, catching the classic 'wrong RAM size' error at build time. Datasheets version with the board. Signature-labeled; an original JAH design, not a public standard.

title: Signature Entry-Point Self-Test
description: A Signature original: the reset handler begins with a self-test that validates the vector table checksum before doing anything else. A corrupt vector table halts with a diagnostic blink pattern. Signature-labeled; an original JAH design, not a public standard.

title: Signature ABI-Diff Versioning
description: A Signature original: the version script is generated from an ABI diff of the previous release, so humans never hand-edit version nodes and drift is impossible. Diffs are reviewed like code. Signature-labeled; an original JAH design, not a public standard.

title: Signature Auto-Managed Overlays

title: Signature Verified Relaxation

title: Signature Root-Manifest Section GC
description: A Signature original: GC roots come from a manifest - interrupt vectors, exported APIs - and anything not reachable from the manifest goes. The manifest is reviewed, so collection is deliberate. Signature-labeled; an original JAH design, not a public standard.

title: Signature Padding-Audited Alignment

title: Signature Automated Map Assertions

title: Signature Formal Script Verification

title: Signature Profile-Driven Region Assignment

title: Signature Dual-Bank Handoff Layout

title: Signature Verified Scatter Copies
